Definition: to germinate, i.e. (figuratively) to (causatively, make) flourish; also (of words), to utter
BiblicalUsage: Nub means to put forth, to bud, to flourish, or to utter. In Psalm 62:10 riches increase and the psalmist warns not to set the heart on them, and in Proverbs 10:31 the mouth of the just brings forth wisdom.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe what a life puts forth shows what it is rooted in, and a just mouth bears wisdom the way a branch bears fruit.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
